mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic growth prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $550B, signaling robust retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, positively affecting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with RSAFS above $550B, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% and CPIAUCSL growth is < 2% YoY, signaling accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 3.5%, signaling a very strong labor market, leads to increased wage pressures and, subsequently, negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE below 3.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating growing housing market activity, suggests improved economic outlook, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 3.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with HOUST growth (t-test p > 0.05).
